title: WhatsApp agent
description: The workbench's own WhatsApp account (a second number, not the owner's): the agent answers people saved in that account's contacts and writes first when the owner asks. The account runs as a linked device in a browser on the home PC (whatsapp-web.js, unofficial: WhatsApp may ban the number). Each message becomes a job in one chat the owner chooses, run isolated: no files, shell, devices, MCP, CLAUDE.md or the owner's dossier, only web search.
isolationReason: a WhatsApp Web session needs a browser on the home PC

data.home: %LOCALAPPDATA%/AIWorkbench/wa-agent (session of the linked device, inbox, events, config.json with the chat id)
